column1: # PSG Academic PDF interface in zh-hant. Columns, separated by a TAB: context <TAB> English <TAB> translation.
# No escapes: a backslash is a backslash. Embedded by apps/psg-academic-pdf/src/i18n.rs; a missing row shows in English.
# Written from the plain meaning of the English; no other product's translations were consulted.

column2: A .tex or .docx file becomes the body of a new project
column3: 一個 .tex 或 .docx 檔案將成為新專案的正文

column2: A command is misspelt, or needs a package the journal template doesn't load. Check the command on this line, or remove it.
column3: 指令拼寫有誤，或需要期刊範本未載入的巨集套件。請檢查這一行的指令，或將其刪除。

column2: A file the manuscript uses is not in the project. Add it with "Bibliography / figures…" and check the spelling: file names are case-sensitive.
column3: 稿件用到的某個檔案不在專案中。請用「參考文獻 / 圖片…」新增，並檢查拼寫：檔名區分大小寫。

column2: A line sticks out into the margin. Rephrase it, allow a hyphenation with \-, or break a long URL or formula.
column3: 有一行伸進了頁邊距。請改寫，用 \- 允許斷詞，或拆分過長的網址或公式。

column2: Add bibliography, figures or other files
column3: 新增參考文獻、圖片或其他檔案

column2: Adding the packages the templates use…
column3: 正在加入範本所需的套件…

column2: An open project keeps the template it was created with; the selection applies to new projects.
column3: 已開啟的專案保留建立時的範本；此處的選擇用於新專案。

column2: Authors refer to these by number.
column3: 作者以編號引用這些機構。

column2: Besides the built-in templates, PSG Academic PDF reads templates from these folders (each template is a folder with a template.toml):
column3: 除內建範本外，PSG Academic PDF 也會從以下資料夾讀取範本（每個範本是一個含 template.toml 的資料夾）：

column3: Biber 無法讀取參考文獻檔案。請確認 main.tex 中指定的 .bib 檔案在專案中。

column2: Cannot auto-update this installation type. Please download manually.
column3: 此安裝類型無法自動更新。請手動下載。

column3: 檢查並匯出完成的 PDF

column3: 捨棄未儲存的變更並重新讀取檔案

column3: 錯誤會中止排版；匯出前最好看看警告。

column3: 實驗功能：使用本機 Pandoc 轉換

column2: Files added; see Activity for their names in the project.
column3: 檔案已新增；在「活動紀錄」中檢視它們在專案中的名稱。

column2: Filter by key, author or title
column3: 依鍵名、作者或標題篩選

column3: 匯入 Word 稿件（實驗功能，使用 Pandoc）

column2: Import a manuscript or create a project from a template to start.
column3: 匯入稿件或從範本新增專案即可開始。
安裝 Pandoc 後可匯入 .docx（實驗功能）

column2: Installed by PSG Academic PDF (TinyTeX {release}), updated {date}. Updates itself weekly.
column3: 由 PSG Academic PDF 安裝（TinyTeX {release}），{date} 更新，每週自動更新。

column2: Installed the TeX packages this document needs: {packages}
column3: 已安裝此文件需要的 TeX 套件：{packages}

column2: Installing TeX for PSG Academic PDF…
column3: 正在為 PSG Academic PDF 安裝 TeX…

column2: Join the beta channel? Betas can have unfinished features and bugs. PSG Academic PDF then updates to every new beta, and to each stable release as soon as it is newer.
column3: 加入測試版通道？測試版可能有未完成的功能和錯誤。之後 PSG Academic PDF 會更新到每個新測試版，以及較新的正式版。

column2: Journal templates set the layout, fonts and citation style. New projects use the selected template.
column3: 期刊範本決定版式、字型和引用格式。新專案使用所選範本。

column2: Leave the beta channel? PSG Academic PDF keeps the version it has and updates again with the first stable release newer than it. It never goes back to an older version.
column3: 退出測試版通道？PSG Academic PDF 保留目前版本，直到出現比它更新的正式版才會再更新。它不會退回舊版本。

column2: Mathematics outside a formula, or a stray _ or ^ in text. Put formulas in $…$, and write \_ for an underscore in text.
column3: 公式之外出現了數學內容，或正文中有多餘的 _ 或 ^。請把公式放在 $…$ 中，正文中的底線寫作 \_。

已用 {template} 在 {path} 中新增專案。

column3: 新專案使用 {template} 範本。可在範本庫中選擇其他範本。

column2: No \label with this name. Check the spelling of the \ref and the \label.
column3: 沒有這個名稱的 \label。請檢查 \ref 與 \label 的拼寫。

column2: No problems in the manuscript's scripts or the bibliography.
column3: 稿件文字與參考文獻中沒有發現問題。

column2: Not opened (one project at a time): {path}
column3: 未開啟（一次只能開啟一個專案）：{path}

column2: Nothing typeset in this session yet.
Open a PSG Academic PDF project folder
column3: 開啟 PSG Academic PDF 專案資料夾
在 PSG PDF 中開啟

Open or create a project to check it.
column3: 請開啟或新增專案以進行檢查。

column2: Open or create a project to import into it.
column3: 開啟或新增專案後才能匯入其中。

column2: Open or create a project, and wait for the TeX check, before compiling.
column3: 編譯前請先開啟或新增專案，並等待 TeX 檢查完成。

column3: 開啟或新增專案並排版後即可匯出 PDF。
已在 PSG PDF 中開啟 {path}。

column3: 已在預設 PDF 檢視器中開啟 {path}。

column2: PSG Academic PDF installs TeX by itself; nothing needs to be installed by hand.
column3: PSG Academic PDF 會自動安裝 TeX，不需要手動安裝任何東西。

column2: PSG PDF isn't installed, so the PDF opened in the default viewer. PSG PDF is a separate download.
column3: 未安裝 PSG PDF，因此已在預設檢視器中開啟 PDF。PSG PDF 需要另外下載。

column2: Planned for a later version; not available yet.
column3: 計畫在後續版本提供，目前尚不可用。

column2: Portable mode: settings and projects are kept in {path}.
column3: 可攜模式：設定與專案保存在 {path}。

column2: Press Auto Typeset to typeset the manuscript; the PDF appears here.
column3: 按「自動排版」排版稿件，PDF 會顯示在這裡。

column2: Projects you open or create appear here.
column3: 開啟或新增的專案會顯示在這裡。

column2: Remove from the list (the folder is kept)
column3: 從清單中移除（資料夾保留）

column2: Replaces the article body; a full document keeps only its body
column3: 取代文章正文；完整文件只保留其正文部分

column2: Required publication details are filled in
column3: 必填的出版資訊已填寫

column2: Save or close your open work first; the update restarts the app.
column3: 請先儲存或關閉進行中的工作；更新會重新啟動應用程式。

column2: Save, check and typeset with latexmk and pdfLaTeX ({keys})
column3: 儲存、檢查並以 latexmk 和 pdfLaTeX 排版（{keys}）

column2: Saved with the project ({keys}) and before every typesetting run.
column3: 隨專案儲存（{keys}），每次排版前也會儲存。

column2: See Manuscript ▸ Title & abstract, Authors and Publication.
column3: 請查看「稿件 ▸ 標題與摘要、作者、出版資訊」。
以 ; 或 , 分隔關鍵詞

column2: Show the PDF beside the manuscript

column3: 顯示 {total} 頁中的前 {shown} 頁。

column2: Some citations or cross-references could not be resolved; the warnings above name them.
column3: 部分引用或交叉參照無法解析；上方的警告列出了它們。

column2: TeX is being installed or updated; typesetting starts once it is done.
column3: 正在安裝或更新 TeX，完成後即可排版。

column2: TeX is installed (TinyTeX {release}) and will keep itself up to date.
column3: TeX 已安裝（TinyTeX {release}），之後會自動保持最新。

column2: TeX is not ready: see Settings ▸ TeX installation.
column3: TeX 尚未就緒：請查看「設定 ▸ TeX 安裝」。

column2: TeX is not ready: {tools} not found. Press Install TeX in Settings ▸ TeX installation.
column3: TeX 尚未就緒：找不到 {tools}。請在「設定 ▸ TeX 安裝」中按「安裝 TeX」。

column2: TeX not found yet ({tools}); PSG Academic PDF installs its own.
column3: 尚未找到 TeX（{tools}），PSG Academic PDF 會自行安裝。

column2: TeX stopped at a fatal error. Fix the first error in the list; the later ones often follow from it.
column3: TeX 遇到致命錯誤而停止。請先修正清單中的第一個錯誤，後面的錯誤往往由它引起。

column2: Text before \begin{document}: the body file must hold the article text only. Import the manuscript again so its preamble is removed.
column3: \begin{document} 之前有文字：正文檔案只能包含文章正文。請重新匯入稿件，以移除其導言區。

column2: The .bib file has a syntax error near the entry named here: a missing comma, brace or quote.
column3: .bib 檔案在此處所列條目附近有語法錯誤：缺少逗號、括號或引號。

column2: The pdfLaTeX journal templates can't typeset Chinese, Japanese or Korean (they need XeLaTeX or LuaLaTeX with a CJK font, which these templates don't use). Give titles, names and references in Latin script (romanized, with the original in the source data), or prepare the article with a CJK-capable template outside PSG Academic PDF.
column3: pdfLaTeX 期刊範本無法排版中文、日文或韓文（需要 XeLaTeX 或 LuaLaTeX 加 CJK 字型，而這些範本不使用它們）。請用拉丁字母（羅馬化，原文保留在來源資料中）提供標題、姓名與參考文獻，或在 PSG Academic PDF 之外使用支援 CJK 的範本排版。

column2: The project folder: compilation happens here and only here
column3: 專案資料夾：編譯只在這裡進行

column2: The templates have no Cyrillic font (T2A encoding). Transliterate Cyrillic names and titles, as most English-language journals require.
column3: 範本沒有西里爾字母字型（T2A 編碼）。請按多數英文期刊的要求，將西里爾字母的姓名與標題轉寫為拉丁字母。

column2: The templates have no Greek text font. In formulas write Greek letters as commands ($\alpha$, $\Omega$); Greek words in running text must be transliterated.
column3: 範本沒有希臘文正文字型。公式中請用指令書寫希臘字母（$\alpha$、$\Omega$）；正文中的希臘文單字必須轉寫。

column2: The templates have no font for this script. Transliterate the text.
column3: 範本沒有這種文字的字型。請將文字轉寫為拉丁字母。

The update is installed. Close {app} to finish; it restarts by itself.
column3: 更新已安裝。關閉 {app} 即可完成，它會自動重新啟動。

column2: There is no folder PSG Academic PDF can install TeX in.
column3: 沒有可供 PSG Academic PDF 安裝 TeX 的資料夾。

column2: This Pandoc is too old: DOCX import needs Pandoc 2.15 or newer
column3: 此 Pandoc 版本過舊：匯入 DOCX 需要 Pandoc 2.15 或更新版本

column2: This citation key is not in the bibliography. Add the entry to the .bib file, or correct the key.
column3: 參考文獻中沒有這個引用鍵。請在 .bib 檔案中新增該條目，或更正引用鍵。

column2: This template doesn't use a bibliography file.
column3: 此範本不使用參考文獻檔案。

column2: Typeset accepted articles into publication-ready PDFs with your journal's template.
column3: 使用期刊範本，將已錄用文章排版為可出版的 PDF。

column2: Typeset to see errors and warnings here.
column3: 排版後會在這裡顯示錯誤和警告。

column2: Typeset to see latexmk's output here.
column3: 排版後會在這裡顯示 latexmk 的輸出。

column2: Typesetting stopped: it took longer than {secs} s.
column3: 排版已停止：耗時超過 {secs} 秒。
正在以 latexmk 和 pdfLaTeX 排版…

column2: Unbalanced braces: a { without its } (or the other way round) near this line.
column3: 括號不配對：這一行附近有 { 缺少對應的 }（或相反）。

column2: Update ready. Close {app} to install it.
column3: 更新已就緒。關閉 {app} 即可安裝。

column2: Using the TeX found on this computer until PSG Academic PDF has installed its own.
column3: 在 PSG Academic PDF 安裝好自己的 TeX 之前，暫時使用這台電腦上的 TeX。

column2: Wait for the current task to finish.
column3: 請等待目前的工作完成。

column2: Worth a look, but they don't stop the export.
column3: 值得一看，但不會阻止匯出。

column2: latexmk normally reruns until this goes away. If it stays, turn on "Rebuild everything each time" and compile again.
column3: latexmk 通常會重複執行直到這條消失。如果一直存在，請開啟「每次都完整重建」後重新編譯。

column2: latexmk runs pdfLaTeX (and Biber for the bibliography) in the project folder, without shell escape.
column3: latexmk 在專案資料夾中執行 pdfLaTeX（以及處理參考文獻的 Biber），不啟用 shell escape。
找不到（選用，用於匯入 DOCX）

column2: pdfLaTeX can't set right-to-left scripts with these templates. Transliterate the text, or prepare the article with a template for XeLaTeX or LuaLaTeX.
column3: 使用這些範本時，pdfLaTeX 無法排版從右到左書寫的文字。請轉寫文字，或使用 XeLaTeX 或 LuaLaTeX 範本準備文章。

column2: pdfLaTeX's fonts have no glyph for this character. Replace it, or write it as a LaTeX command (a Greek letter as $\alpha$, for example).
column3: pdfLaTeX 的字型沒有這個字元的字形。請替換它，或寫成 LaTeX 指令（例如希臘字母寫作 $\alpha$）。

column2: {app} {version} follows the version chosen in the launcher, so it does not update itself.
column3: {app} {version} 使用啟動器中選擇的版本，因此不會自行更新。

column2: {app} {version} is available with the latest features and bug fixes.
column3: {app} {version} 已推出，包含最新功能與錯誤修正。

column2: {file} is not UTF-8 text; save it as UTF-8 and try again.
column3: {file} 不是 UTF-8 文字；請另存為 UTF-8 後重試。

column3: 新專案與應用程式設定都保存在此資料夾。
